figs.name: dp-transmitter-level-measurement-wet-leg-diagram
figs.alt: dp transmitter level measurement on a closed tank with 2500 mm wet leg
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing a closed tank with a 2000 mm span, SG 1.1 liquid and a 2500 mm water wet leg, giving LRV minus 2500 and URV minus 300 mmH2O.
figs.after_h2: Wet Leg and Dry Leg Methods
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">

<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>

<rect x="220" y="70" width="200" height="430" rx="8" fill="#f8fafc" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="221.5" y="260" width="197" height="238.5" fill="#bae6fd"/>
<line x1="220" y1="260" x2="420" y2="260" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="220" y1="175" x2="420" y2="175" stroke="#075985" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>
<text x="320" y="168" font-size="17" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">100% level</text>
<text x="320" y="120" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Vapour space</text>
<text x="320" y="400" font-size="18" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Process liquid</text>
<text x="320" y="424" font-size="18" fill="#075985" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">SG 1.1</text>
<line x1="220" y1="475" x2="420" y2="475" stroke="#075985" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="8 6"/>

<line x1="190" y1="300" x2="190" y2="177" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="190" y1="350" x2="190" y2="473" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="180" y="322" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">H = 2000</text>
<text x="180" y="346" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">mm</text>
<line x1="420" y1="475" x2="560" y2="475" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="4"/>
<text x="490" y="465" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">HP</text>
<polyline points="420,100 720,100 720,475 672,475" fill="none" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="7"/>
<text x="696" y="464" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">LP</text>
<rect x="560" y="445" width="112" height="60" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="616.0" y="481.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">DP TX</text>
<text x="610" y="230" font-size="18" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Wet leg</text>
<text x="610" y="256" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Hw = 2500 mm</text>
<text x="610" y="282" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">SGw = 1.0</text>
<line x1="755" y1="290" x2="755" y2="102" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="755" y1="290" x2="755" y2="473" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="538" width="740" height="52" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="215" y="571" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">LRV = 0 − 2500 = −2500 mmH2O</text>
<text x="585" y="571" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">URV = 2200 − 2500 = −300 mmH2O</text>
<line x1="400" y1="548" x2="400" y2="580" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
</svg>

figs.name: dp-transmitter-level-measurement-lrv-urv-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart to calculate LRV and URV for open and closed tank DP level transmitter
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how to work out LRV and URV for open tanks, closed tanks with a dry leg and closed tanks with a wet leg.
figs.after_h2: DP Type Level Transmitter Range Formulas at a Glance
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 590" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart to find LRV and URV for a DP level transmitter</title>
<rect width="800" height="590" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How to Find LRV and URV</text>
<rect x="230" y="55" width="340" height="46" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="84.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Know H, SG and mounting</text>
<line x1="400" y1="101" x2="400" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="400,110.0 520.0,150 400,190.0 280.0,150" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="156.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Tank type?</text>
<polyline points="280,150 200,150 200,208" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="240" y="140" font-size="17" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Open</text>
<polyline points="520,150 600,150 600,208" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="560" y="140" font-size="17" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Closed</text>
<polygon points="200,210.0 350.0,255 200,300.0 50.0,255" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="200" y="250.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Below HP tap</text>
<text x="200" y="272.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">by h?</text>
<polygon points="600,210.0 750.0,255 600,300.0 450.0,255" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="600" y="250.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">LP leg</text>
<text x="600" y="272.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">dry or wet?</text>
<line x1="140" y1="288" x2="102" y2="338" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="260" y1="288" x2="298" y2="338" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="540" y1="288" x2="502" y2="338" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="660" y1="288" x2="698" y2="338" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="100" y="312" font-size="17" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">No</text>
<text x="300" y="312" font-size="17" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<text x="500" y="312" font-size="17" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Dry</text>
<text x="700" y="312" font-size="17" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Wet</text>
<rect x="10" y="340" width="185" height="120" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="102.5" y="382.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">At HP tap</text>
<text x="102.5" y="405.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">LRV = 0</text>
<text x="102.5" y="428.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">URV = H × SG</text>
<line x1="102" y1="460" x2="265.9" y2="500" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="205" y="340" width="185" height="120" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="297.5" y="382.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">h below HP tap</text>
<text x="297.5" y="405.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">LRV = h × SG</text>
<text x="297.5" y="428.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">URV = (h + H) × SG</text>
<line x1="297" y1="460" x2="353.65" y2="500" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="410" y="340" width="185" height="120" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="502.5" y="382.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Dry leg</text>
<text x="502.5" y="405.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">LRV = 0</text>
<text x="502.5" y="428.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">URV = H × SG</text>
<line x1="502" y1="460" x2="445.9" y2="500" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="605" y="340" width="185" height="120" rx="10" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="697.5" y="371.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Wet leg</text>
<text x="697.5" y="394.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">LRV = −Hw × SGw</text>
<text x="697.5" y="417.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">URV = H × SG</text>
<text x="697.5" y="440.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">minus Hw × SGw</text>
<line x1="697" y1="460" x2="533.65" y2="500" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="150" y="502" width="500" height="66" rx="10" fill="#0284c7" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="529.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Enter LRV and URV</text>
<text x="400.0" y="554.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">with a HART communicator</text>
</svg>

figs.name: dp-transmitter-level-measurement-zero-suppression-infographic
figs.alt: open tank DP level ranges 0 to 500 and 100 to 600 mmwc with zero suppression
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing open tank ranges: 0 to 500 mmwc with the transmitter at the HP tap and 100 to 600 mmwc when mounted 100 mm below.
figs.after_h2: Case 2 : DP Transmitter Installed Below Tapping Point for Open Tank

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Open tank DP level ranges for transmitter at HP tap and 100 mm below the tap</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>

<line x1="90" y1="260.0" x2="500" y2="260.0" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
<text x="82" y="216.0" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">500</text>
<line x1="90" y1="210.0" x2="500" y2="210.0" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
<text x="82" y="166.0" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">600</text>
<line x1="90" y1="160.0" x2="500" y2="160.0" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
<text x="82" y="116.0" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">700</text>
<line x1="90" y1="110.0" x2="500" y2="110.0" stroke="#e5e7eb" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4 4"/>
<text x="90" y="88" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">mmwc</text>
<rect x="130" y="210.0" width="90" height="250" rx="4" fill="#0284c7" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="175" y="340" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Span</text>
<text x="175" y="364" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">500</text>
<rect x="320" y="410.0" width="90" height="50" rx="4" fill="#e0f2fe" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>
<text x="365" y="441" font-size="18" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">H1</text>
<rect x="320" y="160.0" width="90" height="250" rx="4" fill="#075985" stroke="#075985" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="365" y="290" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Span</text>
<text x="365" y="314" font-size="18" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">500</text>
<text x="228" y="216.0" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">URV 500</text>
<text x="228" y="450.0" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">LRV 0</text>
<text x="418" y="166.0" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">URV 600</text>
<text x="418" y="416.0" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">LRV 100</text>
<text x="175" y="490" font-size="18" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Case 1</text>
<text x="175" y="514" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">at HP tap</text>
<text x="365" y="490" font-size="18" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Case 2</text>
<text x="365" y="514" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">100 mm below tap</text>
<rect x="520" y="80" width="265" height="300" rx="14" fill="#f0f9ff" stroke="#0284c7" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="536" y="114" font-size="20" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Case 2 calculation</text>
<text x="536" y="152" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">H1 = 100 mm, H2 = 500 mm</text>
<text x="536" y="186" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">SG = 1.0</text>
<text x="536" y="220" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">LRV = 100 × 1.0</text>
<text x="536" y="254" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">= 100 mmwc</text>
<text x="536" y="288" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">URV = (100 + 500) × 1.0</text>
<text x="536" y="322" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">= 600 mmwc</text>
<text x="536" y="356" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Range = 600 − 100 = 500</text>
<text x="652" y="420" font-size="18" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Span stays 500 mmwc;</text>
<text x="652" y="446" font-size="18" fill="#075985" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">only the zero moves up.</text>
</svg>
